kpis.description: Volume tuyaux HDPE vendus FY25 (corrugated, polypropylene). KPI #1 ADS = transport eau/wastewater/stormwater. Légère baisse post pic.
Part Allied Products FY25 (Nyloplast structures + Infiltrator septic + StormTech chambers). Marges supérieures + bundled selling strategy.
Revenu Infiltrator FY25 (septic + on-site water treatment). Acquisition 2019 ($1.1Md). Cash machine, marges 30%+.
% matières recyclées dans tuyaux HDPE FY25. ADS = plus gros recycleur plastique US (>500M lbs/an). ESG + cost advantage.
Part marché HDPE pipes US FY25. ADS = #1 vs concrete pipes (alternative durable + cost). Gain de part structurel multi-année.
Part end-markets non-résidentiel FY25 (commercial, industrial, agriculture, infra publique). Pivot stratégique hors résidentiel cyclique.

company_description: Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets thermoplastic corrugated pipes and related water management products in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It operates through Pipe, Infiltrator, International, and Allied Products & Other segments. The company offers single, double, and triple wall corrugated polypropylene and polyethylene pipes; plastic leachfield chambers and systems; EZflow synthetic aggregate bundles; wastewater purification through mechanical aeration wastewater for residential and commercial systems; septic tanks and accessories; combined treatment and dispersal systems, including AeroFin, advanced enviro-septic, enviro-septic, and advanced treatment leachfield; and allied products, including storm retention/detention and septic chambers, polyvinyl chloride drainage structures, fittings, and water quality filters and separators. It also purchases and distributes construction fabrics and other geosynthetic products for soil stabilization, reinforcement, filtration, separation, erosion control, and sub-surface drainage, as well as drainage grates and other products. In addition, the company provides PVC hubs, rubber sleeves, and stainless-steel bands. It offers its products for non-residential, residential, agriculture, and infrastructure applications through a network of distribution centers. Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Hilliard, Ohio.
